title: Gen Z Male Attitudes and the Hustle Culture Problem
author: Aaron Renn
summary: Gen Z men reject traditional employment in favor of side hustles, crypto trading, and entrepreneurship. Survey data reveals young men prioritize financial independence through unconventional means rather than full-time jobs. They embrace hustle culture, MLMs, and high-leverage trading, believing hard work guarantees success. This cohort dismisses traditional career paths even after experiencing scams, viewing mindset coaching as equivalent to therapy.
points: Gen Z men prioritize financial independence without traditional full-time employment
Hustle culture, crypto, forex, and MLM culture dominates non-elite Gen Z attitudes
Resistance to job scams and failed ventures; faith in "hard work" persists
Mindset coaching substitutes for mental health treatment
Entrepreneurship and trend-riding valued over expertise and stability
quotes: He's very into the hustle culture. He likes to trade crypto and forex with high leverage.
He's not averse to MLMs or any other way to make money, preferably quickly.
At no point did he express interest in getting a traditional job.” Archived from Aaron Renn on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
